But what would happen if the US left the alliance – and what would a ‘European NATO’
translated_text:

但如果美国退出该联盟会发生什么 — — 以及“欧洲北约”会发生什么

Before a ceasefire was called, Israel bombed the last bridge standing over the Litani River in Lebanon, cutting off the south of the country. 

CGTN’s Adel Mahrouky reports from the site – explaining how the locals have reacted with confusion and fear to the severing of a vital
translated_text:
